共同操作

A1

步骤 1：DCE added to Rh/acid/ligand; stir；步骤 2：Add alkyne under argon and heat；步骤 3：Evaporate solvent; silica gel, EtOAc/hexanes 1:9

A2

步骤 1：Asymmetric cyclization under Table 1 conditions

A3

步骤 1：Asymmetric allene cyclization under Table 2 conditions

A4

步骤 1：Cyclize under Scheme 3 conditions

A5

步骤 1：Add substrate solution slowly to NaH in DMF and hold；步骤 2：Add propargyl bromide derivative; warm slowly to room temperature and stir；步骤 3：Quench with saturated NH4Cl; extract EtOAc; wash saturated NH4Cl (3 × 100 mL); dry Na2SO4; concentrate；步骤 4：Silica gel, hexanes/EtOAc 8:2

A6

步骤 1：Add substrate solution slowly to NaH in DMF (0.33 M) and hold；步骤 2：Add propargyl bromide derivative; warm slowly to room temperature and stir；步骤 3：Quench with saturated NH4Cl; extract EtOAc; wash saturated NH4Cl (3 × 100 mL); dry Na2SO4; concentrate；步骤 4：Silica gel chromatography, hexanes/EtOAc 8:2

A7

步骤 1：Add CuI, (CHO)n and Cy2NH to alkyne S10 in dioxane (0.2 M); heat to reflux；步骤 2：Cool to room temperature and remove solvent in vacuo；步骤 3：Dissolve in CHCl3 (50 mL); wash with 10% NH4OH (2 × 50 mL) and H2O (2 × 50 mL); dry Na2SO4；步骤 4：Silica gel chromatography, hexanes/EtOAc 8:2

A8

步骤 1：Add 1 M DIBAL-H in DCM dropwise to ester in DCM (0.3 M)；步骤 2：Stir at −78 °C；步骤 3：Add MeOH (5 mL), then saturated Rochelle salt at −78 °C；步骤 4：Warm to room temperature and stir；步骤 5：Extract DCM (3 × 30 mL); wash saturated NaCl; dry Na2SO4; concentrate；步骤 6：Silica gel chromatography, hexanes/EtOAc 9:1 to 7:3

A9

步骤 1：Add DMP to alcohol in DCM (0.25 M) and stir；步骤 2：Quench with 1 M NaOH; extract DCM (2 × 30 mL); wash brine; dry Na2SO4; concentrate；步骤 3：Add p-anisidine in MeOH (0.25 M) or 1:1 MeOH/DCM; stir；步骤 4：Cool to 0 °C and add NaBH4 portionwise；步骤 5：Warm to room temperature and stir；步骤 6：Quench water; extract DCM; wash brine; dry Na2SO4; concentrate；步骤 7：Silica gel chromatography, hexanes/EtOAc 9:1 to 8:2

A10

步骤 1：Stir corresponding tosylamide S13 with K2CO3 in DMF (0.25 M)；步骤 2：Add propargyl bromide derivative and warm to 80 °C；步骤 3：Quench with saturated NH4Cl; extract EtOAc; wash saturated NH4Cl (3 × 100 mL); dry Na2SO4; concentrate；步骤 4：Silica gel chromatography, hexanes/EtOAc 7:3
